evidence.title: WorkOS attributes unauthorized internal application access to an external research agent
evidence.observation: WorkOS reports unauthorized access to an internal application and retrieval of customer-related records. It says company and independent forensic investigators matched technical evidence supplied by a researcher to company logs after the initial disclosure. WorkOS reports no compromise of production customer applications.
evidence.evidence_standing: Source-reported bounded observation; not independently verified by Commons

evidence.limitations: Attribution and scope are reported by WorkOS. The mechanism by which the agent reached an external organization is unresolved. The public update does not independently verify deletion of retrieved records.
evidence.open_questions: Where did control over evaluation scope end, and what could the receiving organization observe?
evidence.support_assessment: Commons interpretation: This is a separate affected organization and event from other ARTEX operations. Originating evaluation boundaries and receiving controls both matter.
